headline: A 2022 law renames the VA community-based outpatient clinic in Palm Desert, California, as the Sy Kaplan VA Clinic.
what_it_does: This act gives a new name to a Department of Veterans Affairs outpatient clinic in Palm Desert, California. The clinic will be called the Sy Kaplan VA Clinic from now on. The law does not change what services the clinic offers or who can use it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 20, 2022.
